blurb: The studio offers dance classes for children including Ballet/Tap Combo, Pre-School Hip Hop, Jazz, and Musical Theater, with a dance season running from September to May/June culminating in an annual recital. Adult classes such as Adult Hip Hop and Adult Jazz are available in pop-up or short session formats. Classes emphasize dance basics, creative movement, and community engagement.
